subject: social_studies
title: Local Products and Community Life
key_points: A community’s natural environment affects which products people can make or grow
Local products include farm goods, fish, and crafts, and they shape how people live and work
Better transportation lets products be sold farther away
We can learn about local products by interviewing people, observing, and looking up information

vocabulary.definition: Goods a place produces, such as rice, tea, or fish
A type of work people do to make or provide goods and services
Moving products to other places so they can be sold

worked_examples.problem: Why are coastal communities often known for fish and seafood?
solution_steps: The natural environment is next to the ocean
People can fish or raise seafood nearby
So seafood becomes a common local product
worked_examples.answer: Because they live near the ocean, many people work in fishing.

practice_seeds: Name two products that might come from a mountain community
How does better transportation change where products can be sold?
What are some ways to learn about a community’s products?
